youtube.title: What if you were the guard during the Louvre heist?
youtube.description:
Paris, October 19, 2025. Two "workers" ride a furniture lift up to the Apollo Gallery — and in under 8 minutes, nine crown jewels are gone. One crown was dropped on the way. The other eight are still missing.
You're the guard. What do you do? Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: AFP (Oct 20, 2026 – jewels still missing, suspects await trial) · Paris prosecutor via AFP (about €88M / $102M, under 8 minutes) · ABC News (Empress Eugénie's crown recovered, gallery reopened July 2026)
